--- export_data_graph.sql
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = "gs://bucket/output.csv", format = "csv") AS
GRAPH FinGraph
MATCH (n:Account)
RETURN n.id

--- AST
&ast.ExportData{
  Options: &ast.Options{
    Options: 12,
    Rparen:  67,
    Records: []*ast.OptionsDef{
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 21,
          NameEnd: 24,
          Name:    "uri",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 27,
          ValueEnd: 51,
          Value:    "gs://bucket/output.csv",
        },
      },
      &ast.OptionsDef{
        Name: &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 53,
          NameEnd: 59,
          Name:    "format",
        },
        Value: &ast.StringLiteral{
          ValuePos: 62,
          ValueEnd: 67,
          Value:    "csv",
        },
      },
    },
  },
  Query: &ast.GQLGraphQuery{
    GraphClause: &ast.GQLGraphClause{
      Graph:             72,
      PropertyGraphName: &ast.Path{
        Idents: []*ast.Ident{
          &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 78,
            NameEnd: 86,
            Name:    "FinGraph",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    Query: &ast.GQLMultiLinearQueryStatement{
      Statements: []ast.GQLLinearQueryStatement{
        &ast.GQLSimpleLinearQueryStatement{
          Statements: []ast.GQLPrimitiveQueryStatement{
            &ast.GQLMatch{
              Optional: -1,
              Match:    87,
              Pattern:  &ast.GQLGraphPattern{
                Paths: []*ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{
                  &ast.GQLTopLevelPathPattern{
                    Path: &ast.GQLPathPattern{
                      Terms: []*ast.GQLPathTerm{
                        &ast.GQLPathTerm{
                          Primary: &ast.GQLNodePattern{
                            Lparen:  93,
                            Rparen:  103,
                            Pattern: &ast.GQLElementPatternFiller{
                              EmptyPos: -1,
                              Variable: &ast.Ident{
                                NamePos: 94,
                                NameEnd: 95,
                                Name:    "n",
                              },
                              Label: &ast.GQLLabelFilter{
                                Is:    -1,
                                Colon: 95,
                                Expr:  &ast.GQLNameLabel{
                                  Name: &ast.Ident{
                                    NamePos: 96,
                                    NameEnd: 103,
                                    Name:    "Account",
                                  },
                                },
                              },
                            },
                          },
                        },
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
            &ast.GQLReturn{
              Return: 105,
              Items:  []*ast.GQLReturnItem{
                &ast.GQLReturnItem{
                  Star: -1,
                  Expr: &ast.Path{
                    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                      &ast.Ident{
                        NamePos: 112,
                        NameEnd: 113,
                        Name:    "n",
                      },
                      &ast.Ident{
                        NamePos: 114,
                        NameEnd: 116,
                        Name:    "id",
                      },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
EXPORT DATA OPTIONS (uri = "gs://bucket/output.csv", format = "csv") AS GRAPH FinGraph MATCH (n:Account) RETURN n.id
